concrete_capability_transition: Brownie CLI product completion moves from being blocked by stale repo-local Core Runtime control-plane pointers to a release-safe state where repository compatibility pointers and their guard deterministically direct CLI campaign operators to the independent external CLI automation root while remaining non-authoritative.

strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Removes the release-blocking risk that a restarted or newly scheduled CLI campaign controller could be misdirected by repository compatibility files into the completed Core Runtime campaign root.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development by preserving a correct external control-plane pointer for the independent CLI campaign after CLI-1 through CLI-10 closed all required CLI Product DoD gaps.
answers.new_capability: The CLI campaign can evaluate product completion without a required-before-release control-plane debt that points repo-local compatibility files at the completed Core Runtime campaign root.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: CLI-10 closed restart/recovery behavior, but the repository pointer contract and guard still accepted ~/.codex/automations/brownie-phase-loop/ as the live external root, which is the completed Core Runtime campaign rather than the active CLI campaign.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: CLI product completion would remain release-blocked because stale repo-local pointers could mislead future operators or older tasks into reading the wrong external campaign state.
answers.non_duplicative: CLI-10.1 does not add another resume, output, install, recovery, or progress feature. It closes the single documented release-blocking debt created by stale compatibility metadata after the functional DoD gaps were closed.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. No runtime RPC, JSON-RPC passthrough, or CLI command is added.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. No report, readiness, digest, verdict, history, inspection, or summary surface is added.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: No runtime behavior is intentionally changed; the planned product transition is release eligibility through deterministic control-plane pointer neutralization and guard enforcement.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: Scheduled CLI heartbeats retain the independent external CLI control-plane root and fail fast if repo-local compatibility files regress to the completed Core Runtime root.
answers.milestone_progress: Closes the only open required_before_release CLI campaign debt, enabling the next heartbeat to perform CLI product completion evaluation if validation and review pass.
